title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: federated Copilot connectors read third-party data live through MCP
summary: Hold: Microsoft documents automation for two tenant-wide controls that the briefing reports as undocumented. Graph beta Tenant Configuration Management can apply publisher-type settings and all-users or no-users access; the remaining control paths, package APIs and licensing statements are supported.
